task: Behaviour: load a variable font, select a named instance (FT_Set_Named_Instance), then query FT_Get_Advance/FT_Get_Advances. Pre-feature base ignores HVAR/VVAR advance deltas for named instances (only FT_IS_VARIATION checked), returning the default advance; fixed tree (tt_face_get_metrics, src/sfnt/ttmtx.c) also honors FT_IS_NAMED_INSTANCE, yielding the HVAR/VVAR-adjusted advance. Single file; fixes upstream #1452.
